subject: Nimbus - Draft MAP & timeline (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Sharp <daniel.sharp@nimbus.io>, Emily Chu <emily.chu@nimbus.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus - Draft MAP & timeline (post-demo)

Hi Daniel / Emily,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciated the context on your analytics pipelines and the cost sensitivity around production inference. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and a target close date. High-level items: 

- Target close: 2026-09-30 (end of Q3) — placeholder, please confirm
- Milestone 1 (P0): Provision test cluster + sample dataset ingestion — Owner: Nimbus (Emily) / Redwood SE (Priyom) — due 2026-08-30
- Milestone 2 (P1): Validation bench (latency/cost) + scoring thresholds — Owner: Redwood (Priyom) — due 2026-09-10
- Milestone 3 (P1): SOC2 evidence review & data handling signoff — Owner: Nimbus (Daniel) — due 2026-09-20
- Milestone 4 (P2): Contract + PO + rollout plan — Owner: Nimbus (Daniel) / Redwood AE (Marcus) — target close 2026-09-30

Dependencies called out in the draft: SOC2 artifact timing, procurement approval window, and a short integration spike needed to validate your custom preprocessor. I flagged non-blocking items as P2.

Next steps I recommend: please review the attached MAP, confirm the owner assignments and the target close date, and share any procurement windows or internal blackout dates we should know about. Happy to adjust — we can also run a shorter phased plan if procurement timing forces a longer close.

Proposed quick follow: 30-min lock-step call next Tue/Wed (Aug 24/25) to finalize the plan.

Attachments: NIM_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for product teams
From: Daniel Sharp <daniel.sharp@nimbus.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chu <emily.chu@nimbus.io>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus - Draft MAP & timeline (post-demo)

Marcus — thanks for the thorough recap and the MAP. Helpful. Two quick items from our side after an internal sync: 

1) Procurement / budget update — our Q3 internal budget closes at the end of September, but our procurement committee moved the purchase window to early October due to an internal review. Realistically we need to target a close date of 2026-10-15 to accommodate PO issuance.

2) Prioritization suggestion — the integration spike you proposed is useful but not blocking for our initial pilot. Could we reprioritize the MAP to make the integration spike a P2 item and focus P0/P1 on dataset ingestion + validation bench + SOC2 evidence? That reduces risk to the pilot and matches what our Platform team prefers.

3) SOC2 evidence — security will need to review a subset of artifacts before the validation bench is considered complete. Can Redwood provide an estimated delivery date for the SOC2 artifact pack?

If you can update the MAP with two options (accelerated with higher temporary costs to meet Sep 30, and phased with the Oct 15 close) that would help us decide.

Also copied Emily who owns the integration work.

Thanks,
Daniel Sharp
Head of Platform, Nimbus Analytics
daniel.sharp@nimbus.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus - Draft MAP & timeline (internal)

Team — quick internal note after Daniel's reply:

- He asked for two MAP variants. Priyom, please draft:
  a) "Accelerated" option: preserve full scope, call out additional SE hours and short-term premium to meet 2026-09-30
  b) "Phased" option: drop integration spike to P2, focus P0/P1 items and move contract close to 2026-10-15
- Marcus: confirm commercial levers we can offer if they need the Sep 30 close (one-time onboarding credit, limited pilot discount).
- Priyom: include a clear list of SOC2 artifacts we can provide and ETA for each — security wants dates.

Let's keep internal doc circulation tight — we should turn around the two MAP variants by COB Monday 8/24. I'll review before we send externally.

Laura
VP, Sales Operations (on behalf of Revenue)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Sharp <daniel.sharp@nimbus.io>, Emily Chu <emily.chu@nimbus.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus - MAP variants and revised forecast

Daniel / Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and context. Attached is an updated MAP (NIM_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a shared Drive folder with the draft artifacts. Summary of changes and asks below: 

Summary: we created two MAP variants as requested — "Accelerated" (target close 2026-09-30) and "Phased" (target close 2026-10-15). Given your procurement shift, our default recommendation is the Phased option to reduce upfront scope and risk to the pilot. 

Key changes (Phased):
- Target close: 2026-10-15
- Reprioritized milestones: Integration spike moved to P2; dataset ingestion + validation bench + SOC2 evidence are P0/P1
- Owners: Emily (Nimbus) — dataset ingestion; Priyom (Redwood) — validation bench and performance gating; Daniel (Nimbus) — procurement/PO
- Dependencies: SOC2 artifact pack ETA: Redwood to provide initial artifact list + timeline by 2026-09-01; full artifact delivery by 2026-09-30 (we may supply interim items earlier)
- Procurement note: to hit Oct 15, Nimbus must open PO request by 2026-10-01 (we included a suggested procurement checklist in the MAP)

Attachments and links:
- NIM_MAP_v2.xlsx (attached)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bNimMapDraft
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3821

Next steps:
- Please confirm which MAP variant you prefer (Accelerated vs Phased)
- If Phased: can you confirm internal PO kickoff by 2026-10-01 and that security will review SOC2 artifacts once we provide the initial pack on 2026-09-01?
- Proposed sync: 30 minutes Tue 8/25 @ 11:00 AM PT — happy to move if that doesn't work.

Attachments: NIM_MAP_v2.xlsx

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
